name: Cartoon Music Video
tagline: A song goes in, a cartoon music video with every lyric on the beat comes out.
description: A 2-minute music video where illustrated characters, bold animated lyrics and real footage hit every beat and every sung word. Good for parody songs, brand anthems and launch videos. It needs no generated video: still drawings come alive as moving cut-outs.
bring: An idea for the video, and a reference video if you have one
A song, or lyrics we write together and generate
Optional: your logo, brand colors and screen recordings
get: A 1–2 min 16:9 music video at 1080p60, every lyric on screen on time

needs.name: A music generator, unless you bring a song

steps: Pick the idea and write the lyrics
Make or bring the song, then line up every word with the beat
Draw the characters and one picture per shot, and review them as a storyboard
Animate each part of the song
Review each version in FrameJam until it's right
